title: Three-dimensional model
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees in all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. Begin by drawing the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. This sketch consists of the first loop made up of eight curves. Start with the first line from the point (0.0, 0.7425) to (0.0308, 0.097), followed by the first arc from (0.0308, 0.097) to (0.2248, 0.097) with a midpoint at (0.1278, 0.0). Continue with the second line from (0.2248, 0.097) to (0.2556, 0.7425), then the third line from (0.2556, 0.7425) to (0.2559, 0.7486). Add the fourth line from (0.2559, 0.7486) to (0.2256, 0.75), followed by the fifth line from (0.2256, 0.75) to (0.1945, 0.0977). Draw the second arc from (0.1945, 0.0977) to (0.0611, 0.0977) with a midpoint at (0.1278, 0.0303). Complete the loop with the sixth line from (0.0611, 0.0977) to (0.03, 0.75), the seventh line from (0.03, 0.75) to (0.0, 0.7425). After completing the first loop, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Rotate the scaled two-dimensional sketch using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translate it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Extrude the two-dimensional sketch 0.0476 units in the direction of the normal without extruding in the opposite direction. Finally, create a new solid body from the extruded sketch. The dimensions of the resulting three-dimensional model are a length of 0.2558860583512091 units, a width of 0.7499999682528387 units, and a height of 0.04761641079724444 units.

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
wp = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
sketch = wp.moveTo(0.0, 0.7425) \
           .lineTo(0.0308, 0.097) \
           .threePointArc((0.1278, 0.0), (0.2248, 0.097)) \
           .lineTo(0.2556, 0.7425) \
           .lineTo(0.2559, 0.7486) \
           .lineTo(0.2256, 0.75) \
           .lineTo(0.1945, 0.0977) \
           .threePointArc((0.1278, 0.0303), (0.0611, 0.0977)) \
           .lineTo(0.03, 0.75) \
           .close()

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.0476)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = extrusion

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
W = 0.2559   # X width of the U
H = 0.7500   # Y total length of the U
T = 0.0476   # Z strip thickness (height of material)
t = 0.0350   # in-plane strip thickness (wall)

R = W / 2.0          # outer bend radius
ri = R - t           # inner bend radius
yc = R               # bend center Y location

# Half-annular bend at the bottom (outer radius R, inner radius ri)
bend = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(R, yc)
    .circle(R)
    .circle(ri)
    .extrude(T)
)

# Cut away the upper half of the annulus, keeping the semicircular bend
cutter = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(R, yc)
    .rect(2 * R + 0.1, R + 0.1, centered=(True, False))
    .extrude(T)
)
bend = bend.cut(cutter)

# Straight legs
left_leg = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, yc)
    .lineTo(t, yc)
    .lineTo(t, H)
    .lineTo(0.0, H)
    .close()
    .extrude(T)
)

right_leg = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(W - t, yc)
    .lineTo(W, yc)
    .lineTo(W, H)
    .lineTo(W - t, H)
    .close()
    .extrude(T)
)

# Combine into the U-shaped clip
r = bend.union(left_leg).union(right_leg)

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# U-shaped bent strip: slight taper on legs, rounded bend at bottom,
# constant in-plane strip width, uniform Z thickness.

# Outer U geometry
leg_top_x_outer = 0.2559          # widest point at free ends (X)
bend_y = 0.13                     # tangent height of bend
outer_half_span = 0.06795         # outer bend radius
cx = 0.12795                      # center of bend (X)
w = 0.0476                        # in-plane strip width
th = 0.0476                       # Z thickness

# Outer tangent points
ox_l = cx - outer_half_span       # 0.06
ox_r = cx + outer_half_span       # 0.1959
# Inner bend radius
inner_r = outer_half_span - w     # 0.02035
ix_l = cx - inner_r               # 0.1076
ix_r = cx + inner_r               # 0.1483

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    # outer left leg (free end down to bend)
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.75)
    .lineTo(ox_l, bend_y)
    # outer bend
    .threePointArc((cx, bend_y - outer_half_span), (ox_r, bend_y))
    # outer right leg up to free end
    .lineTo(leg_top_x_outer, 0.75)
    # across the free end to inner edge
    .lineTo(leg_top_x_outer - w, 0.75)
    # inner right leg down to bend
    .lineTo(ix_r, bend_y)
    # inner bend
    .threePointArc((cx, bend_y - inner_r), (ix_l, bend_y))
    # inner left leg up to free end
    .lineTo(w, 0.75)
    .close()
    .extrude(th)
)
